correctness.rationale: For L_n=P_n x K_2 the graph metric is |i-j|+[row change]; a graph-geodesic general-position triple must have i<j<k and alternate rows, yielding exactly 2*C(n,3) triangles; all pairs are edges and no larger faces occur. The oriented triangle-cocycle conditions reduce to offdiagonal four-index rectangle equations. Their all-field solution has dimension 2n+2, and including free diagonal and adjacent monochromatic edge cochains gives ker(d2^T) dimension 5n. Thus rank(d2)=2n(n-3), for n>=4. The n=2,3 exceptions follow directly. Euler-Poincare and H0=Z produce H1 ranks 3,8,3n+1 and H2 rank n(n-4)(n-5)/3 (n>=6). Since the rank is identical in every characteristic, UCT rules out torsion. Independently generated the actual GP triangles from distances and checked oriented boundary ranks over F2,F3,F5 for n=2..8. The all-n conclusion relies on the algebraic normal-form induction, not the finite rank experiment.

value.rationale: The entire simplicial general-position complex of a natural graph family is a motivated topological object. Its torsion-free homology classification reveals a sharp first appearance of 2-dimensional cycles at n=6 and supplies information not recoverable from the known cardinality polynomial. A complete exact all-n structural calculation has independent value even without a claimed homotopy type.

limitations: Only the path ladder P_n x K2 is covered; no homotopy or equivariant-module classification.
